posts.t:
Hey DT-

I think you are spot on here. Price moves between decision points until they no longer hold. Price comes down to the FL at 2, and dips below. We say that tells us price wants to go lower, but I think thats indirect, or rather too direct a statement. What really happens is the fresh demand that existed at the FL has now gone, and price dipped lower to the pocket of demand below before heading back up to supply. With that area now cleared, shorting at the top is a high probability/low risk trade because IF price does fall, the next place where demand is is at the origin of the up move - here is just above the P in point 2, where it says 2. Price then...

I dont intend for this to be pedantic DT, sorry if it seems that way. I am just thinking about the mechanics of what is actually going on. I see that dipping down below the FL with 2, bouncing of the pocket of demand to the left - the SR flip. Once the demand there was gone, down it would go. Genius.

MF

فکر می‌کنم کاملاً درست می‌گی. قیمت بین نقاط تصمیم حرکت می‌کند تا وقتی دیگر پابرجا نمانند. قیمت به فلگ لیمیت در 2 می‌رسد و زیرش فرو می‌رود. می‌گوییم این به ما می‌گوید قیمت می‌خواهد پایین‌تر برود، اما فکر می‌کنم این غیرمستقیم است، یا بلکه بیانی بیش از حد مستقیم. آنچه واقعاً اتفاق می‌افتد این است که تقاضای تازه‌ای که در فلگ لیمیت وجود داشت حالا رفته، و قیمت پایین‌تر به جیب تقاضای زیرین رفت، پیش از آنکه به عرضه برگردد. با پاک شدن آن ناحیه، فروش در بالا معامله‌ای با احتمال بالا/ریسک پایین است، چون اگر قیمت بیفتد، جای بعدی که تقاضا هست مبدأ حرکت صعودی است - این‌جا درست بالای حرف P در نقطهٔ 2 است، جایی که 2 نوشته شده. قیمت بعد…

قصد ندارم این سخت‌گیری باشد DT، ببخش اگر این‌طور به نظر می‌رسد. فقط در حال فکر کردن دربارهٔ سازوکار آنچه واقعاً در جریان است هستم. می‌بینم که فرو رفتن زیر فلگ لیمیت در 2، برگشت از جیب تقاضای سمت چپ - همان سواپ SR. وقتی تقاضای آن‌جا رفت، پایین می‌رفت. نابغه.

Sorry but I had a few questions which are most probably to basic for a lot of peoples here but they keep cropping up over the past few weeks here and I thought I would find the answers myself but I just can’t seem to figure it out 100%..

The idea of Engulf of a S/D zone..is the Engulf only classed as an engulf if it spikes past the S/D limit and either closes above or below as in the chart... or is it also classed as an engulf if it spikes deep into the S/D area?? When we get an Engulf of an area it is usually telling us it wants to go to the other side of that level??...however sometimes that engulf past the area could actually be a fake out and a start of a reversal in the opposite direction??

2. These spikes into the Supply area..are they actually telling us it is consuming the overhead supply and wants to go higher??...is the telling point the prior liquid move into the area??....or could this actually be a normal Pin Bar type of PA set up and telling us it wants to reverse??

3. Red would use candle sticks without wicks at times..in this picture would this be classed as a PA Bullish Engulf??....Is the PA engulf only usable when the prior bar is totally engulfed by the wicks and body or it could actually be used by having a larger body than the prior bar or in a different scenario again??

Sorry for all the questions but if I could get some help please it would be really appreciated..

Cheers,

posts.t:
That was great work by all There was no magic whatsoever in the trade. It was just simple, as they all should be Price had reached a nice HTF FTR, compressed its way down to a FL engulf, and then retraced as far as it possibly could to remain valid

I don't even need to draw charts of this one, as the quality of everybody's charts was perfect ~^o^~
posts.fa:
کار فوق‌العاده‌ای بود از همه. هیچ جادویی در معامله نبود. فقط ساده بود، همان‌طور که همه باید باشند. قیمت به یک FTR خوب در تایم‌فریم بالاتر رسیده بود، راهش را فشرده کرده بود تا به یک اینگالف روی فلگ لیمیت رسید، و بعد تا جایی که می‌توانست برای باقی ماندن معتبر ری‌تست کرد

حتی لازم نیست برای این یکی چارت بکشم، چون کیفیت چارت‌های همه بی‌نقص بود ~^o^~
